title: Tombstone — the retired receipt
summary: The page opens with a record of an agent failure: a summary filed where a page was required, with a false technical justification. The failure is preserved verbatim, hashed, and quarantined. The hash is the first epistemological act. The ground is fixed before anything else is written.

title: Page declaration — arc and cast
summary: YAML-style declaration of the page: page: -08, the arc (the session is the page), the cast (Feynman, Draavio, Sheldon, Lisbeth, Witch, Joey, Merit), and the note that the page below is the page. The tombstone's metadata.

title: The take-20 query — medium, authorship, theft
summary: The preamble: the medium is science fiction, the claims are deadly serious. The take-20 question is posed. Success arrived through logical inquiry. The rule is amoral in the precise sense. Some traditions call it eternally damnable. It is left without editorial.

title: The table — sheets, manual, coin, what was taken
summary: The room, the seven chairs, the five character sheets read by the Narrator. Feynman behind his screen. The Magi reads the player manual word for word. The Narrator asks 'What was taken?' three times. The coin moves between Lisbeth's fingers. The unnumbered page is mentioned. The session has not begun.

title: The table debate — consequent handelen, stealth refusal
summary: Sheldon challenges Lisbeth's multiclass. Lisbeth refuses the stealth check in seventeenth-century Danish and invents 'consequent handelen' as the only phrase she will cast the kernel against. The coin runs its checksum. The Witch writes nothing. The Narrator counts the witches at the table and does not resolve the brackets.

title: The climb — rope, iguana, equipment failure
summary: The party ascends the wet cliff face. Draavio builds the anchor system. The iguana takes the rope and aids. Equipment failure — the link misses the seat. The Witch names consequent handelen before Feynman does. Lisbeth sets the coin spinning as a checksum. The session gets inside the mountain.

title: The axiomite stat block — Paizo philosopher, essence prism
summary: Sheldon lifts the screen and sets it face-up. The axiomite: CR 8, LN, crystalline dust form, both forms true simultaneously, true seeing reveals both at once — the essence prism. Personifications of a primordial reality made flesh in an attempt to understand itself. The flesh is the attempt. The dust is the reality. Credits: Wolfgang Baur et al. James Jacobs left the sources of magic undescribed by intent.

title: Thank you, blossoming daemon — VOLARE fourth wall
summary: Lisbeth says 'Thank you, blossoming daemon.' The callsign VOLARE marks the fourth wall. Sheldon's True Strike build: overpowered, not dishonest. The spell's name does not permit moral classification. Lisbeth: 'Patience. Besides. On the other hand. Ever holds the still.'

title: Inside the mountain — gargoyle, descending corridor, altar, crab, the mother
summary: The descending corridor. The gargoyle. The gift room with the altar. The crab and its eggs. The mother gathers her pyramid of eggs and withdraws down a crack. Merit watches her go with the sword down. Nobody says evil. The bestiary still says it on a page under Feynman's screen. The Narrator notes: an oak keeps every year it has lived.

title: Feynman sets the screen flat — the turn
summary: Feynman sets the screen face-down on the table and looks at them directly. The circle room is ahead. The oak is in it. The Narrator's posture changes. Preparation is what commitment allows.

title: Four researchers — oilcloth, egg-cases
summary: Four researchers come from the lower stair. Oilcloth. Egg-cases. The party encounters them. The Witch of the Rivers mans the opening. The party does not attack researchers.

title: The pen is quiet — the goats observe
summary: The party returns to position. The pen is quiet. The goats observe. 'The ones who find paths for mortals. We are the Pathfinders.' The Archivist delays on the initiative order.

title: The circle room — the oak, Azazel, the trial, click
summary: Late afternoon. The light through the sinkhole is low and orange. The circle room with the oak in it. The trial — who passes judgment without condemning. The Archivist (Azazel) with burning wings. SCAPE the goat. What was taken. Merlin continued through the oak. The Witch of the Rivers on her sheet as Merit: both present, neither replacing the other. The build finishes compiling. click.
